items.title: As you add more independently-configured environments, how likely is at least one to have drifted?
items.description: Grounded in L2's laptop/CI/prod scenario: each environment is set up and patched independently, so each one has some chance of quietly diverging from the reference environment by the time you check. Drag the number of environments and the per-environment drift chance to see why three independently-managed environments (laptop, CI, prod) already puts you at meaningful risk of at least one silently disagreeing with the others — and why that risk climbs fast, not slowly, as more environments get added (a staging tier, a second CI runner, a canary fleet).

params.name: driftProbabilityPercent
params.label: Chance any one environment has drifted from the reference

items.compute: const p = params.driftProbabilityPercent / 100; const probAtLeastOneDrift = (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, params.numEnvironments)) * 100; return { probAtLeastOneDrift };

outputs.label: Probability at least one environment has drifted
